title: Topic 22
japanese_text: <u>虐待</u>は子どもの権利を<u>侵害し</u>、健全な成長を<u>阻む</u>行為だが、親による虐待は<u>後を絶たない</u>。多くの自治体は、子どもが<u>悲惨な</u>目に遭うことを防ぐため、警察と<u>協定</u>を結んでおり、虐待が疑われる事例があれば、警察に協力を<u>要請する</u>ことができる。
english_translation: Abuse is a violation of children's rights and it hinders their healthy development, but there seems to be no end to abuse by parents. Many local authorities have agreements with the police to prevent children from suffering grievous harm, and they can request cooperation from police in any suspected cases of abuse.
